_meta.session: Session 91 — Deep re-mine for missed tables (Gemini 3 Pro + GPT-5.5 + MAI Thinking + Google evals-methodology + Sonnet/Mythos gap)
sources: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card deep re-mine (embedded image FSF table)
GPT-5.5 Deployment Safety deep re-mine (Figures 12-22 + Tables 15/17)
Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 + Mythos Preview gap-mine (62 candidates / 50 with scores)
_meta.notes: 5 parallel deep re-mine agents. Net ~616 new triples. Key SOTAs: GPT-5.5 CTF Pro 96.3%, CVE-Bench 93.1%, MLE-Bench-30 36.67%, Tacit Knowledge 81.67%. Gemini 3.1 Pro LCB Pro 2887, ARC-AGI-2 77.1%, GPQA-D 94.3%. Mythos Preview Kernel 399.42x speedup. Sonnet 4.6 OpenRCA 27.9%, BrowseComp 82.07%, Cybench pass@1 90%. MAI Thinking 1 first-time GLM-5.1 + DeepSeek V4 comparator scores.
